text: Stand sideways to the camera and perform controlled squats for approximately 10 seconds, aiming to reach a 90-degree knee bend at the bottom of each rep. As you squat down, try to keep your shins as vertical as possible and prevent your knees from travelling too far forward past your toes. Keep your torso reasonably upright — a slight forward lean is natural, but try to avoid hunching over too much, as if you're trying to keep your chest facing forward throughout the movement.
